mechanics.statement: Legal cardinal inputs repeatedly displaced the controlled five-by-five block by five pixels along aligned corridors.
mechanics.reopening_condition: Any later legal input with a conflicting displacement or footprint consequence

mechanics.statement: A first-level blue-socket rejection followed by an intervening white contact and blue-socket recontact produced the official level transition.
mechanics.reopening_condition: A disjoint run showing that the intervening white contact is unnecessary or that the same relation fails

mechanics.statement: Each contacted second-level yellow ring disappeared and restored the visible action bar to full.
mechanics.reopening_condition: A later yellow contact that does not disappear or replenish

mechanics.statement: The lower-yellow, white, upper-yellow contact history was rejected at the second-level blue socket and did not transition the level.
mechanics.reopening_condition: Only an official transition isolating a compatible accepted history
